meta.name: coding-standards
meta.description: Baseline cross-project coding conventions for naming, readability, immutability, and code-quality review. Use detailed frontend or backend skills for framework-specific patterns.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 统一团队代码风格与质量规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要跨项目统一的编码约定。
copy.tagline_en: Enforce consistent coding standards across projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs unified coding conventions across projects.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照命名规范、可读性、不可变性等编码标准来审查和生成代码，并遵循 KISS、DRY、YAGNI 原则。
howto.when: 当你开始新项目、审查代码质量、重构代码、设置 lint 规则或指导新成员时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这段代码是否符合命名规范。
say.note: Claude 会检查变量和函数命名是否清晰。

say.text: 重构这个函数，让它遵循 DRY 原则。
say.note: Claude 会提取重复逻辑为可复用函数。

say.text: 检查这个组件是否有不必要的复杂性。
say.note: Claude 会应用 KISS 和 YAGNI 原则。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will review and generate code following coding standards for naming, readability, immutability, and code quality, adhering to KISS, DRY, and YAGNI principles.
howto.when_en: Triggered when starting a new project, reviewing code quality, refactoring, setting up linting rules, or onboarding new contributors.

say_en.text: Review this code for naming conventions.
say_en.note: Claude checks variable and function names for clarity.

say_en.text: Refactor this function to follow DRY.
say_en.note: Claude extracts repeated logic into reusable functions.

say_en.text: Check this component for unnecessary complexity.
say_en.note: Claude applies KISS and YAGNI principles.
